fact: The driver left the track at turn 1 and rejoined after turn 3, gave a position back to car 43, then at the end of the straight after turn 3, he was passed by car 30 at turn 4. Minor contact occurred during that passing manoeuvre.
offence: Alleged breach of Article B1.8.6 of the FIA F1 Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video and in-car video evidence. Although the additional guidelines issued by the Stewards on October 31 advised that a car leaving the track at turn 1 after a Restart should yield the position by Turn 4, the fact that the correct positions were achieved by turn 5 confirms to the Stewards that no further action is required. In leaving the track Car 10 did not gain a position, in fact the car ultimately lost a position to car 30. The minor contact between the cars does not require penalization to either driver.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Decision Car 10 Alleged Leaving The Track And Gaining An Advantage
to: The Team Manager, BWT Alpine F1 Team
